headline: Prime angle, glassy all day — the pick of the East Coast today.
today: Best call anywhere this morning: 2-2.6ft SSE at a prime Ditch angle with light winds essentially all day. No wind window to chase, it stays clean dawn to dusk. Worth the drive if you can swing it — fish or shortboard will work, log the smaller sets. Tides are weak so mid-tide is fine.

daysToWatch.note: N offshore morning holds the prime SSE swell clean into the afternoon lull. Another solid Montauk day if you missed Friday.
Biggest of the week at 3.5ft but a marginal SSW angle and onshore-to-cross wind most of the day. Only the evening NW cleans it up briefly.
